tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch8:8-16For each $a > 0$, let $g_a$ be the Berger metric on $\text{SU}(2)$ defined in Problem 3-10. Compute the sectional curvatures with respect to $g_a$ of the planes spanned by $(X, Y)$, $(Y, Z)$, and $(Z, X)$. Prove that if $a \neq 1$, then $(\text{SU}(2), g_a)$ is homogeneous but not isotropic anywhere. \end{exercise}
